payout_quote: Maricopa County 2026 Election Plan: Poll Worker – Inspectors $16.75/hr; Judges, Voter Registration Clerks, Marshals, Clerks $15.15/hr; Troubleshooters $17.00/hr. (Student clerk rates vary across older documents and are excluded here.)
steps: Apply as a Maricopa County poll worker
Work vote-center shifts on/around Election Day (student clerks: 5:30 a.m.–after 7 p.m.)
catches: Election Day runs 5:30 a.m.–after 7 p.m. (~14 hours).
Student Election Clerk rates conflict across official documents ($13.85/$14.35/$14.70) — confirm current rate before relying on it.
Hiring needs are set per election (primary vs general addendum).
biggest_catch: Student-clerk pay is inconsistently documented — the regular poll-worker hourly rates above are the reliable figures.
eligibility: Registered voters in Maricopa County, 18+ (students 16+ for student program).
timing: Paid per county payroll; biweekly for longer-term temp roles.
